## Fixes & Reliability

- Disconnecting or reconnecting now resets terminal modes left behind by a TUI that died with the connection (such as SGR mouse tracking, Kitty keyboard protocol, alternate screen, bracketed paste, focus reporting, synchronized output and pointer shape) without clearing scrollback, and records the reset in session recordings and rewind.
- Added **Reset Terminal** in the Session menu and Command Palette to clear stuck terminal modes when a remote TUI crashes or an inner SSH hop drops while the outer connection stays open.
- Hardened serial console connections: coordinated port close/reopen so immediate Disconnect → Reconnect no longer fails with "in use", drained pending writes cleanly on close or unplug, stopped dead-driver zero-byte read spin loops, moved unplug detection off the UI thread with replug retries, and fixed custom COM port and baud-rate saving and search in Session Options.

## Rendering & Performance

- Terminal tabs now share a single render thread and emoji atlas, trim hidden offscreen GPU targets while backgrounded or minimized, batch background and decoration draws into contiguous spans, and recover immediately if the graphics device is lost while drawing.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
